name: McAuliffe-Shepard Discovery Center STEM Summer Camps
description_short: Weekly STEM day camps at a science center and planetarium in Concord, NH. Each week has a theme (coding, astronomy, dinosaurs, rockets, astronauts, earth science) aimed at a specific age group.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund if you cancel at least 30 days before the session starts. No refund if you cancel less than 30 days before, except for a documented emergency. Cancellations must be sent by email.

source.title: Summer Camps | Register Today for STEM Camps — McAuliffe-Shepard Discovery Center

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season, which has already ended (today is 2026-10-13). Dates, prices and availability for 2027 are not posted yet.

The page contradicts itself on scholarships. It has an 'Apply for a Scholarship' link and a scholarship policy, but also says 'Scholarships to cover camp fees are no longer available through the Discovery Center due to high demand.' Financial aid is left blank for that reason.
Session prices are the standard non-member rates. Discounts: siblings in the same camp ($256 for Week 1, $335 for other weeks), members ($268 / $320), and member siblings ($236 / $295).
Week 1 is Monday to Thursday because of the holiday, so it costs less. Weeks 3 and 5 (ages 5-7) end at 2pm. The other weeks end at 3pm.
Sold-out weeks offered a waitlist through kthompson@starhop.com. Weeks 3 and 6 were not marked sold out, but the season is over, so their availability is set to unknown.
Registration dates are for 2026. Early registration for returning campers and members began Jan 15, 2026, and open registration began Feb 1, 2026.
